coverage_note: Ooredoo retail network (Espaces Ooredoo, City Shops, Espaces Services) via the public API — every record but one carries a real operator coordinate; the exception is a store whose API point falls in the sea, pinned to its commune centroid instead (geo_method commune_centroid). A few points carry inaccurate source coords, so their derived wilaya/commune may be off; operator_wilaya preserves the operator's declared wilaya.
